question: what commits the expected execution population before EEE envelopes are verified?

vcgb_mechanisms: suite version bound by suite_hash over the canonical scenario set
submit_intent creates the execution attempts under test
fetch_evidence must return EEE envelopes for every submitted intent including denials
full result bundles are required for headline claims
failed scenarios must not be omitted
missing scenario IDs make a result bundle invalid on its face

portable_invariant: valid included evidence != complete run coverage
resolution: Do not extend EEE with a new expected-population object when VCGB already supplies the benchmark population and run-completeness boundary.
non_claims: This is not a Veklom maintainer endorsement.
This does not claim EEE alone proves production-wide completeness.
This does not claim VCGB proves a system records every production execution.
